Partial success means the issuer is reachable, so the losses are concentrated in the gateway hop the code points at. This is a recurring debit, so RBI's 24-hour cooling window is longer than any backoff this class would justify: the timing is set by regulation, not by the hazard estimate, and the pre-debit notice has to go out before the retry does.
